Description:
[font=Georgia][b][size=6][i][color=#9900ff][u][center]Shifting Mines[/center][/u][/color][/i][/size][/b][color=#00ffff][size=5][b]
[u][i]Other The Mines Family Mods:[/i][/u][/b][/size][/color][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8914][size=4]
[/size][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8890][size=4]Shifting Monsters[/size][/url]


[size=3]Every day you visit the mines you will get a new view of the mines you already know.
Every day the mines will change their appearance to give a little more variability to your adventures.
Fresh air for this place inhabited by fearsome and ferocious monsters!
[/size][size=3]You can also change the options to your liking to choose the variant of each mine that you like the most. [/size]


[b][i][color=#ff0000][size=5][u]Known problem: [/u][/size][/color][/i][/b]
[size=3]The farm cave uses the same assets as the mines, so don't panic if you enter the cave and see that everything is engulfed in flames![/size]
[color=#ff00ff][b][color=#ffff00][b][u][i][size=3]
[/size]
[size=5]Mod Options:[/size][/i][/u][/b][/color][color=#ff7700] 
[/color][size=3][color=#f4f4f4][b]I recommend using the Mod: "[/b][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]". To read what each option does from this menu[/b][/color]
[/size]
[color=#00ff00][size=5][b][i]The 'Random' variable allows the mines to change daily, but you can modify these options as you wish. [/i][/b][/size][/color][/b][/color][/font]

Downloads.Description: Unzip the zip file and move the unzipped folder to the game mods folder. Configure with Generic Mod Config Menu.

Unzip and move to the mods folder. If you like the mod consider clicking the 'Endorse' button at the top of this page, it helps me a lot :D
